title: Render multi-amount item descriptions in pilot prompts
description:
The current pilot rendering for `GAME_GET_MULTI_AMOUNT` drops the per-item descriptions entirely. In the existing `multi_amount_combat` golden, the model-facing prompt shows `Choices (0)` and only the `amounts=[N,N,...]` response format, even though the raw bridge result includes `items` with the blockers being assigned damage.

This leaves the model without the information it needs to map each amount to a concrete item, which can affect combat damage assignment and any other multi-amount decisions.

Reproduction:
- Run `make regen-golden K=multi_amount_combat`
- Inspect `puppeteer/tests/golden/prompts/multi_amount_combat.json`
- The multi-amount decision currently renders as `Choices (0)` with no item list

Expected behavior: render the multi-amount `items` in the LLM-facing decision text with stable ordering and clear index/item mapping so the model can choose amounts intentionally.
